Title: Generally Available: Azure Ultra Disk Storage is now available in Spain Central

Body.Content:
Now available in Spain Central region, Azure Ultra Disk Storage provides high-performance along with low sub-millisecond latency for your most-demanding workloads.

Azure Ultra Disk Storage offers high throughput, high IOPS, and consistent low latency disk storage for Azure virtual machines (VMs). Ultra Disk is suited for data-intensive workloads such as SAP HANA, top-tier databases, and transaction-heavy workloads.
